description: Motion-direction tuning, feature-based attention. Two bell-shaped curves centered at 0 deg: attend-contralateral-stimulus (peak 1.0) vs attend-fixation (peak ~0.9). The feature-based effect SHARPENS the attended curve: it is enhanced near the peak but relatively SUPPRESSED at the flanks, so the attended curve is narrower than attend-fixation and the two curves differ (and cross) at the flanks. The flank difference (attend-fixation above attend-contralateral at |dir| >= ~90 deg) is the binding signature.
